# stb (vendored)

`stb_image.h` (v2.30) from https://github.com/nothings/stb at commit
`2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`, unmodified. Public domain or MIT, at the user's choice (see the end of
the file). steading compiles it into `src/colony/realmap.cpp` only, PNG only, with every symbol `static`, to read a
real map's rasters (`docs/WORLD_PACKAGE.md`).
